_doc: ADVERSARIAL content fixture for scripts/concepts/build-page.js and the three round templates (review finding F009). Derived from examples/neutral/content.json: every text field carries quotes, a closing script tag, an img tag with an onerror handler, an inline script that would set data-fd-pwned on <html> if it ever ran, an HTML entity, and U+2028; ids, colours (including the fore-edge strip and tile swatches), font families, the comparison font_url and image paths keep their valid values so the only validation failure is the one named below.
_how_it_is_used: 1. As is: pages.home.front.image is 'img/../x.jpg'. build-page.js must refuse it (exit 1) naming that key; the image regex allows only img/<name>.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp).

2. With pages.home.front.image set to the value of _variant.front_image_ok (null): the build must SUCCEED for round1, round2 and round3, the fd-content JSON block in the output must contain no raw ', no 0. The hostile text should be visible as text in the screenshot.
Keys that begin with '_' are documentation; the builder drops them before validation.

audit_intro: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep The site was reviewed at 500, 1280 and 1600px before any letters were drawn. Each finding says what it changes for the font. The items marked first are the ones to fix before the face is chosen.

audit.finding: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Small capital labels repeat the heading under them.
audit.fix: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep “Latest” sits over “What came in this week”; “Chapters” over “Four ways in”. Keep a label only where it adds a fact.
audit.font_effect: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Large. With the labels gone, each heading stands alone, so the display face carries section identity by itself at 25 to 35px.

audit.finding: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Boxed cards that lift on hover.
audit.fix: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep The four chapter cards rise with a shadow. Use photo, numeral, name and count, with no box.
audit.font_effect: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep The chapter names become the only structure, so the Bold at 18px matters.

audit.finding: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Georgia cannot hold the 16.8px plate titles.
audit.fix: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep The plate titles look lighter than the body text beside them.
audit.font_effect: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep The hardest constraint: at 16.8px one screen pixel is 60 font units, so the Regular's thinnest stroke needs about 45 units.

audit.finding: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Two date formats.
audit.fix: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep The home page says “3 March 2026”; the grid says “2026-03-03”. Use one spelled-out date.
audit.font_effect: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep None, if dates move to the body face.

guidelines.lead: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Differ from the body face in at least two ways
guidelines.text: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep out of contrast, stress angle, serif shape and width. Georgia is a sturdy text serif; a similar face looks like a mistake beside it.

guidelines.lead: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Work from 15px to 80px:
guidelines.text: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep 15px chapter numerals, 16.8px titles in a grid, 25 to 35px section headings, 32 to 48px essay titles, an 80px title on cloth, and the wordmark in spaced capitals at 22 to 26px.

guidelines.lead: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Two weights,
guidelines.text: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Regular and a clearly heavier Bold. The lowercase matters most: titles are Title Case, and only the wordmark is set in capitals.

guidelines.lead: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Two character traps from the real titles:
guidelines.text: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep most titles hold a no-break space before the last word, and some type the apostrophe as a straight ' which must draw as a curly one.

text.desc: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep An upright, low-contrast bracketed serif with flared terminals: a text cut meant to hold the 16.8px plate titles with even colour.
text.risk: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep It is the closest to Georgia and is distinct from it by its flared ends and tighter fit. It is here as the control.

display.desc: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep The same drawing cut for large sizes: thinner hairlines, longer serifs and tighter spacing, so the 48 to 80px titles gain presence.
display.risk: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Below 24px its hairlines fall under a pixel; it only works as the large half of a two-cut face.

article.title: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Bracket's Last Stand
paragraphs: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep The bracket in question held a shelf in the harbourmaster's office for sixty years, and the shelf held the tide tables. When it gave way on a Tuesday the tables went into the sink and the harbourmaster went to the café.
Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep This is the story of the afternoon it took to find another, which is also the story of every shop on the front, in the order you would walk them.
article.heading: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Three shops and a shed
article.paragraph_after: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep The chandlery had brackets but only in pairs; the hardware shop had one, bent; the shed at the end of the wall had six, in a biscuit tin, and would not sell them.

verdict.headline: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep What the reviewer says: build Sampler as two cuts
verdict.summary: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep The two-cut face is the only entry that holds the 16.8px plate titles and still has presence at 80px. On its own the text cut is plain above 48px, and on its own the display cut smudges below 24px.

items.text: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Even colour at 16.8px, serifs intact at 48px, and the 80px wordmark gains the longer serifs. The switch at 40px is not visible on any page here.
Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Best at the 48px essay title and the 16.8px grid. Weakest at the 80px wordmark, the plainest of the three.
Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Best at 64 to 80px. At 16.8px its hairlines fall under a pixel and the serifs smudge.

verdict.next: Bracket's "Last" Stand & <b>   line-sep Build the variable font with opsz 24 to 72 and the text cut as the default; measure where Chrome maps font-optical-sizing: auto with opsz.py before fixing the axis ends.
